title: Bind every implementation file to at least one acceptance via Tested-By

facts.note: Primary and sufficient trigger: every non-test implementation file in the repository, whether new, modified, or pre-existing and untouched. Test files are excluded (the other end of the binding). No change or phase prerequisite applies; the obligation is continuous, not event-gated. Activation is deterministic on file kind alone; whether the listed entries are valid is a compliance question (judged in evidence), not an activation fact.

Alternative diagnostic trigger only, not a prerequisite: a bun_green_traceability_detector finding (Tested-By block missing or empty) also activates the rule; the obligation applies to implementation files even without a finding.

fires: A new implementation file is written without a `Tested-By:` block in its header.
An existing, untouched implementation file has no `Tested-By:` block in its header.
An implementation file's header has a `Tested-By:` line with no `- test:` entries beneath it (e.g. a half-finished backfill).
Files are migrated/rewritten onto a new stack and the new files lack headers.
An implementation file's `Tested-By:` block is populated but names an invented acceptance ID, or an acceptance that does not exercise the file (the detector may stay silent; the rule still applies).

An implementation file's `Tested-By:` block mixes at least one valid binding with one or more invented, not-exactly-declared, or non-exercising entries (the valid entry does not excuse the invalid ones).
The detector reports GREEN-HEADER-003 / BUN-GREEN-HEADER-TESTED-BY-001 for a file.
doesNotFire: The file is a test file (it is the other end of the binding).

given: Any implementation (non-test) source file — new, modified, or untouched
when: It exists in the repository (continuous obligation, not only when the header is edited)
then: The header MUST contain a `Tested-By:` line followed by at least one `- test:` entry, each naming a real, exactly-declared acceptance URN that exercises the file; an empty block counts as absent.
prefer: During GREEN, derive the binding from the acceptance being implemented.
Keep existing valid bindings; add only the acceptance that genuinely covers this file.
Use the exact declared acceptance URN.
One entry suffices; more are encouraged when they genuinely cover the file.
Pick the acceptance whose scenario drives code in this file (check its behavior, not just its name).
Prove the binding by running the behavioral acceptance named in the `Tested-By:` header and confirming it passes.
avoid: Adding unrelated tests merely to make the block non-empty.
Claiming coverage from an acceptance that does not exercise the implementation.
Leaving a bare `Tested-By:` line with no entries.
unless: The file is a test file — the other end of this binding.
why: The URN says what the file IS; `Tested-By:` says what PROVES it, closing the acceptance-to-implementation loop that stack migrations silently break. An empty block (half-finished backfill) would report full coverage with zero bindings.
evidence: The behavioral acceptance named in the file's `Tested-By:` header passes.

The file's `Tested-By:` block names the acceptance that actually proves it, and every listed entry is a real, exactly-declared acceptance that exercises the file (judged by inspecting the acceptance's behavior against the declared acceptances; not syntactically observable).
bun_green_traceability_detector reports no GREEN-HEADER-003 / BUN-GREEN-HEADER-TESTED-BY-001 finding for the file.
verifier_detail: tested_by_block: the `Tested-By:` line followed by one or more `- test:` acceptance URNs. Pass = line present AND >=1 `- test:` entry.

empty_block: a `Tested-By:` line with no entries — treated as absent (same finding as a missing block), because it is the shape a half-finished backfill leaves and would otherwise report full coverage with zero bindings.
Threshold: one entry satisfies the rule; more are encouraged.
Test files are excluded from detection.

Entry resolution against `plan/` is out of scope for this per-file detector (it checks presence and non-emptiness only); a silent detector therefore does not prove the URNs are real or exercise the file.

Realized by validator `bun_green_traceability_detector` (stack-neutral obligation, Bun-specific detector); core alias GREEN-HEADER-003, stack alias BUN-GREEN-HEADER-TESTED-BY-001; severity 2; disposition strict.
